core_obligations: Cover V by opens W_i whose descent data are effective and such that the datum on V carries W_i times X into X times W_i, and choose for each i a scheme U_i over S with an isomorphism alpha_i from the canonical descent datum on X times U_i to the restricted datum on W_i (proof lines 9155-9160).

For each pair of indices consider the preimage under alpha_i of the intersection W_i and W_j inside X times U_i, note that it is compatible with descent data, and apply descent along the fpqc covering X to S to obtain an open U_ij of U_i with that preimage equal to X times U_ij (proof lines 9160-9167).

Use that the identity of the intersection is compatible with descent data, and fpqc descent for morphisms of schemes, to obtain a unique morphism phi_ij from U_ij to U_ji over S (proof lines 9168-9171).

Verify that the resulting data are glueing data for schemes -- the author marks this verification as omitted -- and glue the U_i along the U_ij to a scheme U over S with U_ij equal to the intersections and phi_ij the identities (proof lines 9172-9177).
Pull back to X and use the isomorphisms alpha_i on the members of the cover to assemble the required isomorphism from X times U to V (proof lines 9178-9179).
proof_roadmap: Choose the local realisations of the datum over a cover of V (proof lines 9155-9160).
Realise the overlaps as pullbacks of opens of the U_i, using descent for open subschemes (proof lines 9160-9167).
Descend the identity of the overlap to the gluing morphisms (proof lines 9168-9171).
Glue the local schemes to U over S (proof lines 9172-9177).
Assemble the isomorphism from X times U to V (proof lines 9178-9179).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a descent datum relative to a surjective quasi-compact flat morphism X to S is effective as soon as it is locally effective on the total space, that is, as soon as every point of V lies in an open W which the datum carries into X times W and over which the restricted datum is effective (statement lines 9144-9152). The proof glues the local realisations. It covers V by such opens, chooses for each a scheme U_i over S with an isomorphism of descent data from the canonical datum of X times U_i to the restricted datum on W_i, and then, for each pair of indices, applies descent along the fpqc covering X to S to the open subscheme of X times U_i obtained as the preimage under that isomorphism of the overlap of W_i and W_j, producing opens U_ij of U_i with the expected description (proof lines 9155-9167). Since the identity of the overlap is compatible with descent data it descends to a unique morphism between these opens, and the resulting data are glueing data for schemes, so the U_i glue to a single scheme U over S (proof lines 9168-9177); pulling back along X and using the chosen isomorphisms produces the required isomorphism from X times U to V (proof lines 9178-9179). The claim is H2: two descent steps are used in earnest, one to recognise the overlaps as pullbacks of opens downstairs and one to descend the gluing morphisms, and the argument is displayed in full.
